question: Which of the drugs reported produces tachycardia and palpitations as adverse effects ?:
analysis: Salbutamol is a beta-2 adrenergic agonist commonly used as a bronchodilator in conditions like asthma. It can cause tachycardia and palpitations as adverse effects due to its action on beta-2 receptors, which can also affect beta-1 receptors in the heart at higher doses or in sensitive individuals. Atenolol, a beta-blocker, typically reduces heart rate. Lidocaine, a local anesthetic and antiarrhythmic, does not commonly cause tachycardia. Metamizole, an analgesic and antipyretic, is not associated with these cardiac effects.
